نذدكر (form VIII)
# نَذْدَكِرُ (naḏdakiru) /nað.da.ki.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِذْدَكَرَ (iḏdakara)
# نُذْدَكَرُ (nuḏdakaru) /nuð.da.ka.ru/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِذْدَكَرَ (iḏdakara)
# نَذْدَكِرَ (naḏdakira) /nað.da.ki.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِذْدَكَرَ (iḏdakara)
# نُذْدَكَرَ (nuḏdakara) /nuð.da.ka.ra/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
